items.headline: Jai’Den Thomas has 167 total yards and 3 touchdowns to lead UNLV past Akron 38-10
items.description: — Jackson Arnold threw for 290 yards and three touchdowns, Jai’Den Thomas had 167 total yards and three touchdowns, and UNLV beat Akron 38-10 on Saturday.

items.headline: Jackson, White lead North Texas to commanding 44-6 win over UNLV.
items.description: — Tayven Jackson passed for two touchdowns and ran for another, Jahiem White scored twice and North Texas defeated UNLV 44-6 on Saturday.
